description: This file defines an abstract class PadNode that extends PcbNode, representing a pad component on a PCB with properties like position and size. It includes methods for parsing shape types and checking connection status.

classes.name: PadNode
classes.description: An abstract class representing a PCB pad with position and size, capable of parsing shape types and checking connection status.

methods.name: PadNode
methods.description: Constructor initializing PadNode with name, index, and child nodes; sets position and size points.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a given point is connected to this pad based on position and size.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Static method to parse children nodes and instantiate specific shape subclasses based on a shape string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the pad node, including position and size.
